b: BOC’s Hi Scores was the original portal opening up to give us an early glimpse of future possibilities says Gerry Valle
Hi Scores by Boards of Canada

Like many, I fell in love with Boards of Canada when I first listened to 1998’s Music Has The Right To Children. Even friends who weren’t necessarily into electronica were taken by its surreal cover, its psychedelic wanderings. The haunting synth melodies, processed vocal samples and polite beats felt like the soundtrack to a lost 1970’s science and nature TV program.
